summary: BioLineRx Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing a registered direct offering and concurrent private placement. The company agreed to sell 1,348,921 ADSs (or ADS equivalents) at $2.78 per ADS, with accompanying warrants to purchase up to 2,023,382 ADSs at $2.78 per ADS, expiring in five years. Gross proceeds are expected to be $3.75 million, with closing on or about August 31, 2026. Chardan acted as exclusive placement agent. The ATM facility was reduced to zero. This is a capital raise, not a special situation; thus, the category is 'Capital Returns' as the closest match, though it is routine financing.
